annotations.title: What happened since I last looked

description: What happened on the account while you were away: fills, rejections, approvals, positions closed (stop, take-profit, plan, liquidation), plan rules fired, price alerts, warnings near liquidation or the daily loss limit. Reading moves your place on, so a new session gets only what is new: act on each event before the next read; to read again, pass an earlier last_event_id as after (your place stays put). Use at the start of a session, or with wait_seconds (up to 30) to wait for the next event. Not for current state (use get_my_positions). Next: act on what changed, e.g. get_my_positions.

after.description: An event id (last_event_id of an earlier answer) to read after it and keep your own place; leave out to continue from where you last checked

wait_seconds.description: When nothing is new, wait up to this long (0-30) for the next event

name: get_my_new_events

agent_id.description: The agent it concerns, if any

data.description: The event's fields, listed per type in /llms.txt (Events) and in the skill's references/events.md; sizes are size_base, shares and distances fractions

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

type.description: Event type, e.g. order.filled, position.closed, plan.triggered, price.alert

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

events.description: Events in the order they happened

last_event_id.description: Pass as after to keep your own place; null when nothing new was read

more.description: True when more events are waiting: call again at once

since.description: last_check (where this agent last stopped), after, or first_look (the last 24 hours)

title: What happened since I last looked
